title: Manual reviewers display generic badge instead of adding member name
answers: Why do manual reviewers only show 'Added by teammate' instead of who added them?
How is manual reviewer attribution resolved in Signals reports?
Why is the reviewer explanation missing for manually added reviewers?
body:
Symptom: Reviewers on a report display a generic "Added by teammate" badge instead of showing who added them.
Root cause: products/signals/backend/report_generation/resolve_reviewers.py:_with_reviewer_presentation set explanation to None for manual reviewers instead of resolving adder identity.
Fix pattern: Traverse historical artefacts via products/signals/backend/report_generation/resolve_reviewers.py:trusted_manual_reviewer_adders to identify the authentic creator User and set explanation to "Added by {name}".
Constraints: Applies only to reviewer entries whose reason starts with "Added as a reviewer by "; falls back to the generic badge if author resolution fails.
applies: Signals report reviewer presentation and serialization in products/signals/backend
says: Reviewers on our report show generic Added by teammate instead of user name
Display the actual person who invited each reviewer on the report summary
Cannot tell which team member requested my review on the signals report
Replace the generic teammate badge with the specific colleague who added them
